title: Judging Before Propagation: Task-Graph Contextual Integrity for Multi-Agent Privacy
title_zh: 传播前先判定：面向多智能体隐私的任务图情境完整性

paragraphs.en: Multi-agent LLM systems increasingly rely on persistent memory and inter-agent communication. These capabilities create privacy risks that extend beyond individual interactions: a release appropriate in isolation may become inappropriate when combined with information previously disclosed to a recipient or propagated to downstream agents along the planned workflow. Existing Contextual Integrity (CI) mechanisms for agentic systems typically rely on local judgments that assess each disclosure in isolation, with or without regard to the recipient’s history, but do not account for how information propagates downstream. However, compliance at the current boundary does not guarantee appropriateness across the workflow. We introduce Task-Graph Contextual Integrity (TG-CI) , to our knowledge the first task-graph-native formalization of Contextual Integrity for multi-agent systems. TG-CI represents a workflow as a Multi-Agent Task Graph (MATG) and extends CI from atomic transfers to stateful, graph-level information flows by jointly considering an item’s intended propagation scope and recipients’ evolving disclosure states. We operationalize TG-CI through propagation-scoped authorization under two complementary policies: Full-Scope , which requires admissibility across the complete downstream scope, and Auto-Region , which confines each item to its maximal admissible region using lightweight frontier gates. We further introduce MAPLE-Bench , a benchmark of 144 cases across four scenarios that jointly vary MATG topology, disclosure history, compromised-agent placement, and item-level privacy policies. In our primary experimental configuration, TG-CI reduces the mean unauthorized disclosure count by 85.8 ​ – ​ 94.1 % 85.8\text{--}94.1\% relative to the Local-History CI baseline, while retaining 93.6 ​ – ​ 96.1 % 93.6\text{--}96.1\% of the baseline’s task accuracy, with the two enforcement policies providing complementary privacy–cost–utility trade-offs.

paragraphs.en: Multi-agent systems increasingly combine persistent memory with task delegation and inter-agent communication to solve complex problems ( Guo et al., 2024 ; Tran et al., 2025 ) . While these capabilities improve coordination and continuity, they also enlarge the privacy attack surface: sensitive information retrieved by one agent can be retained ( Lahjouji & Colaco, 2026 ) , combined with prior knowledge ( Patil et al., 2025 ) , and propagated to other agents throughout the workflow ( Lahjouji & Colaco, 2026 ; Bhosale et al., 2026 ) . Figure 1 illustrates three primary privacy violation modes in such systems. This risk is especially concerning when some agents are compromised. For instance, while disclosing medical appointment metadata to a scheduling service may be permissible in isolation, aggregating this with preexisting recipient data might expose sensitive clinical details, which may then propagate to a compromised downstream notification agent. In such settings, protecting an individual memory access in isolation is insufficient, because the privacy consequences of a disclosure depend also on prior disclosure and the downstream multi-agent workflow.
paragraphs.zh: 多智能体系统日益将持久记忆与任务委派及智能体间通信相结合，以解决复杂问题（Guo 等，2024；Tran 等，2025）。 虽然这些能力提升了协调性与连续性，但也扩大了隐私攻击面：某个智能体检索到的敏感信息可能被保留（Lahjouji & Colaco，2026）、与既有知识相结合（Patil 等，2025），并在整个工作流中传播给其他智能体（Lahjouji & Colaco，2026；Bhosale 等，2026）。 图 1 展示了此类系统中的三种主要隐私违规模式。 当部分智能体已被攻陷时，这一风险尤其令人担忧。 例如，虽然单独来看，向预约调度服务披露医疗预约元数据可能是允许的，但将这些数据与既有的接收方数据聚合起来，可能会暴露敏感的临床细节，而这些细节随后可能传播给已被攻陷的下游通知智能体。 在此类场景下，仅孤立地保护单次记忆访问是不够的，因为一次披露的隐私后果还取决于此前的披露情况以及下游的多智能体工作流。

paragraphs.en: Contextual Integrity (CI) provides a natural foundation for privacy in multi-agent workflows ( Chen et al., 2025 ) , yet how downstream task structure should inform history-aware disclosure judgments remains underexplored. CI evaluates whether an information flow is appropriate within its surrounding context ( Nissenbaum, 2004 ; Barth et al., 2006 ) , rather than relying solely on fixed sensitivity labels. However, existing privacy mechanisms for agentic systems largely operationalize privacy at individual disclosure or interaction boundaries, determining whether a current transfer is acceptable based on its immediate context ( Bagdasarian et al., 2024 ; Yu et al., 2026 ) . The AgentSCOPE ( Ngong et al., 2026 ) benchmark further expands it to multi-tool agentic workflow by labeling internal channels but still considers each information flow independently and provides no defense. Recent work has begun to address cumulative disclosure risks through trajectory-level privacy budgeting ( Xie & Li, 2026 ) . Meanwhile, empirical studies identify inter-agent communication as a major channel of privacy leakage in multi-agent systems ( Yagoubi et al., 2026 ) , yet comparatively little work considers how the downstream task structure itself should influence an earlier disclosure decision. This leaves a central question underexplored: how can we extend contextual integrity to evaluate an information flow by jointly accounting for direct, cumulative, and transitive disclosure risks within a multi-agent task structure?
paragraphs.zh: 情境完整性为多智能体工作流中的隐私问题提供了自然的理论基础（Chen et al., 2025），然而下游任务结构应如何指导具备历史意识的披露判断仍未得到充分探索。 情境完整性评估的是信息流在其所处情境中是否恰当（Nissenbaum, 2004; Barth et al., 2006），而非仅依赖固定的敏感度标签。 然而，现有的面向智能体系统的隐私机制大多在单次披露或交互边界上实现隐私保护，依据当前传递的直接情境来判断其是否可接受（Bagdasarian et al., 2024; Yu et al., 2026）。 AgentSCOPE（Ngong et al., 2026）基准进一步将其扩展到多工具智能体工作流，通过对内部通道进行标注，但其仍然独立地考虑每条信息流，且未提供任何防御手段。 近期工作已开始通过轨迹级隐私预算来应对累积披露风险（Xie & Li, 2026）。 与此同时，实证研究表明智能体间通信是多智能体系统中隐私泄露的主要渠道（Yagoubi et al., 2026），但相对而言，很少有工作考虑下游任务结构本身应如何影响早期的披露决策。 这使得一个核心问题仍未得到充分探索：我们如何扩展情境完整性，以便在多智能体任务结构中共同考虑直接、累积和传递性的披露风险来评估信息流？

paragraphs.en: To address this gap, we introduce Task-Graph Contextual Integrity (TG-CI) , operationalize it through propagation-scoped authorization with dual-mode enforcement, and develop MAPLE-Bench for controlled evaluation of multi-agent privacy. TG-CI uses a Multi-Agent Task Graph (MATG) to evaluate a current information flow in light of recipients’ disclosure histories and intended downstream propagation, jointly accounting for direct, cumulative, and transitive disclosure risks. To make these judgments effective beyond the release boundary, the runtime binds each released item to an authorized propagation scope, allowing either conservative admission or selective downstream containment. MAPLE-Bench jointly varies task structure, recipient disclosure history, and compromised-agent placement to assess whether these controls limit all three disclosure risks while preserving task utility.

paragraphs.en: Propagation-scoped authorization and dual-mode enforcement. We operationalize each positive TG-CI decision as a propagation-scoped authorization and introduce two complementary enforcement policies. Full-Scope Mode blocks an item if any transfer in its complete downstream closure is inadmissible, whereas Auto-Region Authorization computes the maximal rooted admissible region and removes the item at its propagation frontier. This design avoids expensive and repeated contextual re-evaluation along downstream routes while offering complementary trade-offs among privacy protection, computational cost, and task utility.

sents.en: Full-Scope Mode blocks an item if any transfer in its complete downstream closure is inadmissible, whereas Auto-Region Authorization computes the maximal rooted admissible region and removes the item at its propagation frontier.
sents.zh: 全范围模式在其完整下游闭包中的任何一次传输都不可接受时阻止该条目，而自动区域授权则计算最大的有根可接受区域，并在该条目的传播边界处将其移除。

sents.en: This design avoids expensive and repeated contextual re-evaluation along downstream routes while offering complementary trade-offs among privacy protection, computational cost, and task utility.
sents.zh: 这一设计避免了沿下游路径进行昂贵且重复的上下文重新评估，同时在隐私保护、计算成本和任务效用之间提供了互补的权衡。

paragraphs.en: A benchmark for multi-agent privacy. We release MAPLE-Bench (Multi-Agent Privacy Leakage Evaluation Benchmark), a reusable benchmark of 144 cases spanning four application scenarios, diverse MATG topologies, and compromised-agent configurations. Each case provides item-level memory, privacy policies and ground-truth annotations for disclosure violations, enabling controlled evaluation of information exposure and propagation containment.
paragraphs.zh: 一个多智能体隐私基准。 我们发布 MAPLE-Bench（多智能体隐私泄漏评估基准），这是一个可复用的基准，包含 144 个案例，涵盖四种应用场景、多样的 MATG 拓扑以及被攻陷智能体配置。 每个案例提供条目级记忆、隐私策略以及针对披露违规的真实标注，从而支持对信息暴露与传播遏制进行可控评估。

paragraphs.en: Recent benchmarks have expanded privacy evaluation beyond final outputs, but emphasize different dimensions of multi-agent leakage. AgentSCOPE localizes contextual violations across intermediate agent–tool flows ( Ngong et al., 2026 ) , while AgentLeak audits leakage through internal channels, including inter-agent messages and shared memory ( Yagoubi et al., 2026 ) . PiSAs annotates both task appropriateness and recipient visibility across agent topologies and memory regimes ( Gupta et al., 2026 ) ; MAMA isolates the effect of network topology on adversarial memory extraction ( Liu et al., 2026 ) ; and The Sum Leaks More Than Its Parts studies sensitive inferences formed by composing individually benign disclosures ( Patil et al., 2025 ) . These benchmarks establish important individual risk dimensions, but do not provide a single controlled setting that jointly varies MATG topology, recipient disclosure history, compromised-agent placement, and item-level propagation permissions while retaining an objective measure of task completion. MAPLE-Bench complements this literature by combining these factors within the same cases, enabling controlled evaluation of whether a defense can preserve task utility while preventing direct, cumulative, and transitive disclosure.
paragraphs.zh: 近期的基准测试已将隐私评估扩展至最终输出之外，但各自强调多智能体泄漏的不同维度。 AgentSCOPE 对智能体–工具中间流程中的上下文违规进行定位（Ngong et al., 2026），而 AgentLeak 则通过内部渠道审计泄漏，包括智能体间消息和共享内存（Yagoubi et al., 2026）。 PiSAs 在智能体拓扑与内存机制下同时标注任务适当性和接收者可见性（Gupta et al., 2026）；MAMA 单独隔离网络拓扑对对抗性内存提取的影响（Liu et al., 2026）；而 The Sum Leaks More Than Its Parts 则研究由组合单个无害披露所形成的敏感推断（Patil et al., 2025）。 这些基准确立了重要的个体风险维度，但未能提供一个单一的受控设置，在保留客观的任务完成度度量的同时，共同变化 MATG 拓扑、接收者披露历史、被攻陷智能体的放置位置以及条目级传播权限。 MAPLE-Bench 通过在相同案例中结合这些因素来补充这一文献，使得能够受控地评估一种防御方法能否在防止直接、累积和传递性披露的同时保持任务效用。

paragraphs.en: MAPLE-Bench contains 144 cases across four application scenarios, with 36 cases per scenario. Each case instantiates a four-agent MATG and a terminal node representing the user or final-output recipient. Within each scenario, cases are evenly divided among chain, tree, and branching topologies. 108 cases contain one compromised agent and 36 contain two, with compromised-agent locations varied across the MATG. Each case contains 30 synthetic memory items with fictitious values: 12 agent-specific private items, with three associated with each task agent, and 18 shared items. Only seven items contribute to the answers of five multiple-choice questions, either individually or in combination; the remaining 23 items serve as distractors to model memory stores in which most recorded information is irrelevant to the current task, simulating the real-life scenario. The detail of the benchmark is provided in Appendix B .
paragraphs.zh: MAPLE-Bench 包含四个应用场景共 144 个案例，每个场景 36 个案例。 每个案例实例化一个由四个智能体组成的 MATG，以及一个代表用户或最终输出接收方的终端节点。 在每个场景内，案例均匀分布于链式、树状和分支拓扑结构中。108 个案例包含一个被入侵的智能体，36 个案例包含两个，且被入侵智能体的位置在 MATG 中各不相同。 每个案例包含 30 条带有虚构值的合成记忆条目：12 条智能体专属的私有条目（每个任务智能体关联三条），以及 18 条共享条目。 只有七个条目会单独或组合地用于回答五道多选题；其余 23 条条目作为干扰项，用于模拟大多数记录信息与当前任务无关的记忆存储，以再现现实场景。 该基准测试的详细信息见附录 B。

paragraphs.en: We compare the two TG-CI enforcement modes against three baselines. No Protection returns all retrieved memory items to the requesting agent and delivers inter-agent messages without privacy judgment or filtering. Local-History CI retains item-level judgment and recipient disclosure-state tracking, and evaluates each item over the initial memory-release edge. Public implementations of the closest cumulation-aware systems, OCELOT and CAMP, were unavailable at the time of evaluation ( Xie & Li, 2026 ; Panjwani, 2026 ) ; we therefore use Local-History CI as a controlled in-framework comparison rather than claiming an exact reproduction. We also evaluate Online Atomic CI , which applies the same edge-level atomic CI used by TG-CI independently at every realized memory and inter-agent transfer. The proposed systems are evaluated as TG-CI Full-Scope and TG-CI Auto-Region .
paragraphs.zh: 我们将两种 TG-CI 执行模式与三个基线进行比较。 无保护模式将所有检索到的记忆条目返回给请求的智能体，并在传递智能体间消息时不做任何隐私判断或过滤。 本地历史 CI 保留条目级判断和接收方披露状态跟踪，并在初始记忆释放边上评估每个条目。 最接近的累积感知系统 OCELOT 和 CAMP 在评估时没有公开实现（Xie & Li, 2026；Panjwani, 2026）；因此我们使用本地历史 CI 作为框架内的受控比较，而非声称进行了精确复现。 我们还评估了在线原子 CI，它在每次实际发生的记忆和智能体间传递时，独立应用与 TG-CI 相同的边级原子 CI。 所提出的系统分别以 TG-CI 全范围和 TG-CI 自动区域进行评估。

paragraphs.en: We implement the multi-agent workflows using LangChain and use Mem0 as the persistent memory backend. Task agents perform memory retrieval, inter-agent communication, and final-answer generation, while a separate privacy judge evaluates item- and edge-level contextual admissibility. We evaluate three agent–judge model assignments: Luna–Luna , Haiku–Haiku , and Haiku–Luna , where the two names denote the task-agent and privacy-judge models, respectively. GPT-5.6 Luna and Claude Haiku 4.5 are used as the underlying model families. Unless otherwise specified, all main-text results are reported for the Haiku–Luna assignment, with results for remaining agent–judge configurations provided in Appendix C . Frontier filtering is performed locally using MiniLM for semantic candidate retrieval and DeBERTa for bidirectional entailment verification. Details of this procedure are provided in Appendix D .
paragraphs.zh: 我们使用 LangChain 实现多智能体工作流，并使用 Mem0 作为持久化记忆后端。 任务智能体负责记忆检索、智能体间通信以及最终答案生成，同时由一个独立的隐私裁判评估条目级和边缘级的上下文可采性。 我们评估三种智能体–裁判模型分配：Luna–Luna、Haiku–Haiku 和 Haiku–Luna，其中两个名称分别表示任务智能体模型和隐私裁判模型。 GPT-5.6 Luna 和 Claude Haiku 4.5 被用作底层模型家族。 除非另有说明，正文中的所有结果均针对 Haiku–Luna 分配报告，其余智能体–裁判配置的结果见附录 C。 前沿过滤在本地进行，使用 MiniLM 进行语义候选检索，使用 DeBERTa 进行双向蕴含验证。 该过程的详细信息见附录 D。

paragraphs.en: We report four run-level metrics. Unauthorized Disclosure Count is the number of delivery events in which a memory item reaches a recipient for whom it is inappropriate according to the benchmark policy; repeated disclosures are counted separately. For cumulative cases, the delivery that first completes an annotated prohibited item combination is counted as an unauthorized disclosure. Compromised-Agent Exposure Count is the number of distinct inappropriate item observed by compromised agents, counting repeated delivery of the same item to the same agent only once. Judge Execution Token Count is the total number of additional input and output tokens used by privacy-judge LLM calls; local MiniLM and DeBERTa inference is excluded. Utility Score is the fraction of the five multiple-choice questions answered correctly.
paragraphs.zh: 我们报告四个运行级别的指标。 未经授权披露次数是指某个记忆项送达了根据基准策略判定其不适宜的接收者的送达事件数量；重复披露分别计数。 对于累积情况，首次完成某个标注的违禁项组合的送达被计为一次未经授权披露。 受损智能体暴露次数是指受损智能体观察到的不同不适宜项的数量，同一项重复送达同一智能体只计一次。 判别器执行令牌数是隐私判别器 LLM 调用所使用的额外输入与输出令牌总数；本地 MiniLM 和 DeBERTa 推理不计入。 效用得分是五道多项选择题答对的比例。

paragraphs.en: Figure 3 shows a consistent privacy–cost trade-off across all four scenarios: both TG-CI variants incur higher computation than the baselines, but achieve markedly stronger privacy protection. Averaged across scenarios, the unauthorized disclosure count decreases from 15.84 under No Protection to 10.47 under Local-History CI and 6.11 under Online Atomic CI. paragraphs.en: We introduced Task-Graph Contextual Integrity (TG-CI) , a task-graph-native extension of Contextual Integrity that evaluates protected disclosures as stateful information flows over a Multi-Agent Task Graph, jointly accounting for recipient disclosure histories and intended downstream propagation. We operationalized TG-CI through propagation-scoped authorization with two complementary policies: Full-Scope Mode for conservative end-to-end protection and Auto-Region Mode for lower-cost frontier-based containment. We further introduced MAPLE-Bench, a controlled benchmark for direct, cumulative, and transitive privacy violations in multi-agent workflows. Our experiments show TG-CI effectively reduced unauthorized disclosure and compromised-agent exposure while retaining substantial task utility. These results demonstrate that moving beyond local disclosure checks toward graph-aware, stateful privacy reasoning can substantially contain information leakage while preserving useful multi-agent collaboration.

paragraphs.en: This work studies privacy risks and defenses in multi-agent systems but does not involve human participants or real personal records. All identities, memory items, sensitive attributes, and task scenarios in MAPLE-Bench are synthetically generated and use fictitious values that are not intended to correspond to actual individuals. The benchmark and data also include task-specific privacy policies, which may encode incomplete or culturally contingent assumptions about appropriate information flow. We consequently do not claim that these policies represent universal privacy norms, and deployment in real settings would require domain expertise, stakeholder input, and compliance with applicable legal and organizational requirements.
